equal.why: na is one value: null, undefined and every NaN payload and sign encode as 7FF8000000000000
the same specials with the na spellings swapped
column keys sort, so the order they are given in does not matter
keys sort by UTF-8 bytes, not by UTF-16 units
the refusal sentence is not part of the digest
an omitted bar is a null bar
refusals sort, so the order they are given in does not matter
an integer identity field and its decimal string are one value
rows null means "not given", and a matching rows changes nothing
a JSON integer is the double of the same value
an integer past 2**53 that is exactly a double is that double, in both halves
